root_cause.text: The iommupt unmap_pages function did not update the TLB gather range to cover the full actual unmapped size when a partial unmap of a large/contiguous IOPTE caused more to be unmapped than requested, leading to an incomplete invalidation.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `gather_range_pages(iotlb_gather, iommu_table, iova, len, ...)` to `gather_range_pages(iotlb_gather, iommu_table, iova, unmap.unmapped, ...)`, and the commit message explicitly states that the gather was only flushing the requested range, not the extra unmapped range, causing a short invalidation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Use actual unmapped length instead of requested length when gathering pages for TLB invalidation, fixing a potential mismatch in IOMMU unmap operations.
intent_record.what: Changed the fourth argument of gather_range_pages() from `len` to `unmap.unmapped` in the unmap_pages function.
intent_record.how: The function now passes the actual number of bytes unmapped (unmap.unmapped) instead of the originally requested length (len) to gather_range_pages, which likely collects pages for TLB invalidation. This ensures the invalidation covers only the pages that were actually unmapped, preventing over- or under-invalidation.

vuln_statements.explanation: The TLB gather range was set using the requested size instead of the actual unmapped size (unmap.unmapped), leading to incomplete invalidation when a partial unmap unmapped more pages than requested.
